dispute_token_is_fot.meaning: the configured disputeToken is a fee-on-transfer token

dispute_tree_called.meaning: a user has called disputeTree() and sent disputeAmount tokens

full_amount_recorded.meaning: disputeTree() recorded the full disputeAmount and disputer without recording the actually received amount

tree_updates_blocked.meaning: no new Merkle trees can be published and tree revocation is blocked, freezing claims on stale data

assumptions: The disputeToken is a fee-on-transfer token as configured by the governor.
The user's disputeTree() deposit is a legitimate use, not a malicious attack.
resolveDispute() is the only function that clears the disputer and enables tree updates.

unresolved.description: The report does not give a numeric fee or received-amount definition; the fee-on-transfer shortfall is only illustrated (e.g., 1000 vs 990), so the exact balance relation cannot be encoded.

limitations: The impact is formalized as the absence of the blocked-tree-updates condition under the stated deposit scenario; the underlying balance arithmetic is not numerically bound.
The report does not specify the exact mechanism linking resolveDispute() revert to tree publication/revocation, so the relation is kept at the report-stated observable level.
